name: Serverless API (Lambda + API Gateway HTTP API)
summary: A Lambda function behind an API Gateway HTTP API, returning a public HTTPS URL. Scales to zero, needs no VPC, and is the cheapest way to stand up an endpoint.

parameters.name: log_retention_days
parameters.description: CloudWatch Logs never expire by default and bill indefinitely.

notes: Deploys a placeholder handler that returns JSON, so the URL visibly works. Runtime is fixed at Python 3.13 - the module generates the code, so it is not a choice the caller makes. Free Tier covers demo traffic entirely.
